description: Source code for unit tests of the LocationAPI class in the OrangeHRM Admin API plugin, specifically testing various CRUD operations and validation rules for location-related endpoints.

classes.name: LocationAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for the LocationAPI, extending EndpointTestCase, testing location retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and validation rules.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating the LocationAPI instance and loading fixture data.

methods.name: getTestCasesByKey
methods.description: Loads specific test case data from fixture files based on a provided key.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Tests the getter and setter methods for the LocationService dependency within LocationAPI.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single location by ID and asserts the correctness of the returned data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the rule for the 'getOne' endpoint.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all locations with specified parameters.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the rule for the 'getAll' endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new location with provided parameters.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the creation request against its validation rules.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing location, given its ID and new parameters.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the update request against its validation rules.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a location and verifies location list count before and after deletion.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the delete request against its validation rules.
